description:
The formulas \( (
eg p\land q)\lor(p\land
eg q) \) and \( (p\lor q)\land(
eg p\lor
eg q) \) are DNF and CNF respectively, each true exactly when the two input values differ.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalNormalForms.xor_normal_forms :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.IsDnf Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalNormalForms.xorDnf ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.IsCnf Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalNormalForms.xorCnf ∧
      (∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation (Fin 2)),
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval v Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalNormalForms.xorDnf = (v 0 != v 1)) ∧
        ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation (Fin 2)),
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval v Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalNormalForms.xorCnf = (v 0 != v 1)
